summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Bread and batter leavening rely on CO2 gas release during microbial fermentation (Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Leuconostoc). Toddy is produced by fermenting palm sap with wild yeasts. Cheese ripening uses specific bacteria (Propionibacterium shermanii for Swiss cheese holes) and fungi (Penicillium roqueforti/camemberti).

conceptBreakdown.content:
### 2.1 Dough Fermentation in Household Foods
- **Dosa & Idli Batter**: Fermented predominantly by lactic acid bacteria like *Leuconostoc mesenteroides* and *Streptococcus faecalis*. The characteristic puffed-up appearance of dough is due to the rapid accumulation and entrapment of **Carbon Dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$)** gas produced during anaerobic fermentation.
- **Bread Leavening**: Bread dough is fermented using **Baker’s Yeast (*Saccharomyces cerevisiae*)**. Alcoholic fermentation converts sugars into ethanol and $\text{CO}_2$; baking evaporates ethanol and expands $\text{CO}_2$ bubbles, giving bread its soft, porous, spongy crumb texture.

### 2.2 Traditional Fermented Foods & Toddy
- **Toddy**: A traditional fermented alcoholic beverage popular in Southern India produced by fermenting the sweet sap tapped from palm inflorescences (*Caryota urens*) using naturally occurring wild yeasts.
- Other fermented foods include **Tempeh** (fermented soybeans from *Rhizopus oligosporus*), **Tofu** (soybean curd), and **Sauerkraut** (fermented cabbage).

### 2.3 Microbial Cheese Typology & Ripening

| Cheese Variety | Ripening Microorganism | Microbial Taxon | Diagnostic Physical & Flavor Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Swiss Cheese** | ***Propionibacterium shermanii*** | Bacterium | Large characteristic "eyes" (holes) formed by massive **$\text{CO}_2$ gas bubbles** generated during propionic acid fermentation |
| **Roquefort Cheese** | ***Penicillium roqueforti*** | Fungus (Ascomycete) | Ripened by fungal mycelium growing internally through cheese cracks, creating distinctive **blue-green veins** and a sharp, piquant flavor |
| **Camembert Cheese** | ***Penicillium camemberti*** | Fungus (Ascomycete) | Ripened by fungal surface crust, creating a soft, creamy interior |

conceptBreakdown.heading: Single-Cell Protein (SCP)
conceptBreakdown.title: Single-Cell Protein (SCP)
conceptBreakdown.content: Single-Cell Protein refers to microbial biomass (such as Spirulina cyanobacterium and Methylophilus methylotrophus bacterium) cultivated on agricultural wastes as a protein-rich food/feed supplement to bridge global nutritional protein deficits.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Mycoprotein (Quorn)
conceptBreakdown.title: Mycoprotein (Quorn)
conceptBreakdown.content: Mycoprotein produced by cultivating the filamentous soil fungus Fusarium venenatum in continuous-flow bioreactors provides high-protein, high-fiber meat substitutes with low saturated fat content.
